name: web-cream-analytics-landing-with-flat-illustrations-and-hard-shadows
title: Cream analytics page with flat character illustration, thick black outlines and raspberry buttons
whatItIs: A cream page with a nav, a bold centred headline 'Understand your visitors Grow your business', an email field with a raspberry button in a hard-shadow outline, two flat-illustrated characters at desks with a cactus and charts over a wavy black line, logos, a video placeholder with hard shadow, and three step illustrations.
whatItMeans: Friendly and quirky; flat drawings and hard shadows make analytics approachable.
techniques: Outline every element in thick black with a hard offset shadow.
Draw flat characters in muted colours.
Divide sections with a wavy black line.
Use raspberry as the single accent.

vocabulary.definition: Drawings with flat colour and simple shapes.
A button in the single accent colour.
